description: Search for NIP-52 calendar events (date-based and time-based). Supports temporal filters (start/end time ranges), geohash location filtering, hashtag filtering, and the edufeed educational attributes (free, registrationRequired, attendanceMode, educationalLevel). Returns events from the configured calendar relay. TIME SEMANTICS (NIP-52): `start`/`end` are the raw tags — `end` is EXCLUSIVE and is omitted for one-day and instantaneous events, so never read a missing `end` as "unknown". Use `effectiveEnd` (Unix seconds when the event is over), `allDay` (31922: whole days, no clock time) and `lastDay` (all-day events: the inclusive last calendar day). Times of 31923 events are in `startTzid`/`endTzid`. ATTRIBUTES: `attributes` carries registration, price (free = amount 0), attendance mode (online/offline/mixed) and Bildungsstufe; a missing field means "no statement", never "no" or "not free". AUTHOR: every event has `author` {name, bot}; `bot: true` marks an automated account such as an event mirror or crawler — group or de-emphasise those unless the user asks for imports. Operators may hide bulk sources by default (see `hiddenSources` in the result); pass includeHiddenSources: true to see them. When presenting an event to the user, render it as a markdown link: prefer the event `url` (the edufeed-app viewer at <base>/<naddr>, which shows fuller details) over `sourcePage` (the original external event page). Never construct an naddr or viewer URL yourself — use the `naddr`/`url` fields as returned.

attendanceMode.description: Only online, in-person (offline) or hybrid (mixed) events; untagged events match none.

community.description: Return calendar events shared into this community (Communikey). Accepts a hex pubkey or npub; resolve a community name with resolve_author. Combines with a time range (startAfter/startBefore/endAfter/endBefore) in a single server-side query, so "events shared with X next week" is one call. With a geohash the relay applies the community filter in its topic search and post-filters one page of 250 hits by location.

educationalLevel.description: Only events for this KIM Bildungsstufe concept URI, e.g. https://w3id.org/kim/educationalLevel/level_C (Fortbildung), level_A (Hochschule), level_B (Vorbereitungsdienst), level_1 (Primarbereich).

endAfter.description: Only events still running after this Unix timestamp (strict: NIP-52 `end` is exclusive, so an event ending exactly then is over). "Ongoing or upcoming" = endAfter: now; one-day and instantaneous events are included via their effective end.

endBefore.description: Only events over by this Unix timestamp (inclusive: an event ending exactly then counts)

free.description: true: only events tagged free of charge (price 0). Events without a price statement are NOT returned, so leave it unset unless the user insists on free. false adds no filter.

includeHiddenSources.description: Also return events from operator-hidden bulk sources (event mirrors, imported catalogues). Default false; the result reports how many were hidden.

kinds.description: NIP-52 kinds to query (default: [31922, 31923]). 31922 = date-based event, 31923 = time-based event (both in `events`); 31924 = calendar, a titled list of event coordinates (in `calendars`); 31925 = RSVP, one user's attendance intention (in `rsvps`). "Who is coming to event X" = kinds [31925] with the event's coordinate in `references`; "events in calendar Y" = resolve the calendar's eventRefs. Time-range, geohash and attribute filters match event kinds only, so combining them with 31924/31925 returns no calendars or RSVPs.

participants.description: Filter by participant pubkeys (`p` tags, hex): events naming them, or RSVPs to their events.

query.description: Free-text topic for the events. Combines with a time range (startAfter/startBefore/endAfter/endBefore) in a single server-side query — e.g. "events about X in the next week" is one call. With a geohash, the relay runs the topic search and filters one page of 250 hits by location, so "events about X near a place" works but may return fewer than limit.

references.description: Filter by referenced coordinates (`a` tags): with kinds [31925] the event an RSVP answers (`31923:<pubkey>:<d>`); with kinds [31924] calendars listing that event; with event kinds, events requesting inclusion in that calendar (`31924:<pubkey>:<d>`).

registrationRequired.description: Only events that do (true) or do not (false) require registration; untagged events match neither.

since.description: Return events created at or after this Unix timestamp

startAfter.description: Only events starting at or after this Unix timestamp (inclusive)

startBefore.description: Only events starting at or before this Unix timestamp (inclusive)

until.description: Return events created at or before this Unix timestamp

name: search_calendar_events
title: Search Calendar Events
